answer: Each identity is a vertex in the EigenTrust graph, where centrality derives from weighted, reciprocal endorsements rather than self-assertion. Exponential temporal decay imposes a half-life on reputation, so sustained honest service is needed to maintain trust. A freshly spawned sybil has few credible paths and near-zero eigenvector centrality; its trust signal remains at the nadir until independently trusted peers validate consistent behavior, preventing it from passing consensus.
